# Handoff to master: fixed-library height-two gate

Date: 2026-09-29.

## Outcome

Transfer reconstructed and archive hashes verified. U2 internal-fiber order, U4 exact-sequence terminology, U6 fine-measurability hypothesis and A1 all preserved. Known source-claim-table corrections V5-06/07/09 were retained rather than reintroduced.

The completed gate establishes:

- Branch cancellation: current poset is P0 restricted to support.
- Exact boundary restriction, including zero removed-row entries in retained columns.
- No creation of relative H2 / column dependencies by conditioning.
- Safe-query deactivation exactly through lost anchoring; equality of retained cell counts decides descendants of a safe query.
- Actual matroid deletion and augmented graphic-matroid minor descriptions.
- Legally reachable useful activation/deactivation, each minimal on three states.
- Exact support DP; polynomial height-one feasibility; general height-two feasibility remains in NP with classification open.
- Sharp largest finite gap n-1-ceil(log2 n) on a connected actual-height-two family.
- Exact complement-closed connected parity-bipartite family, n=2^k:

  d\_ad=k, d\_RF=2^(k-1)+k-1, gap=n/2-1.

The latter is already height one. It is a strong structured-family result but not evidence that depth penalties require repair triangles.

## Evidence

274,738 graph/matrix query comparisons over 4,496 naturally labelled posets through six vertices; no mismatches. All 639,433 effective libraries through four vertices plus 10,600 seeded larger instances. Independent matrix/tree checks: 1,730 instances; 94 reported protocol nodes checked against original queries. Independent exact boundary-restriction checks: 337,138, all passed. Extremal families checked through n=12; parity exact depths 3,6,11 at n=4,8,16.

See ../computations/README.md for scripts, seeds, limits and file descriptions.

## Files to read next

1. HEIGHT2\_ADAPTIVE\_MASTER\_AUDIT.md
2. MAIN\_THEOREM.md
3. REPAIR\_GRAPH\_DYNAMICS.md
4. ADAPTIVE\_DEPTH\_THEORY.md
5. FIXED\_LIBRARY\_IDENTIFICATION.md
6. COMPLEXITY\_AUDIT.md and COMPLEXITY\_INDEPENDENT\_AUDIT.md
7. LITERATURE\_PRIORITY\_AUDIT.md and HOSTILE\_REFEREE\_REPORTS.md

All are under:

C:\Users\brian\Documents\Math Latex etc\Papers for Publication\The MIND\Height2 Fixed Library Gate 2026-09-29\research

## Thread decision and proposed next task

This task retained shared state through transfer reconstruction, proof search, verification and final integration. Those phases are now complete and the evidence is saved. A further general RF-IDENT classification is a self-contained research phase, so a new task with this compact handoff is preferable to carrying exploratory history. No new task has been created.

For that difficult proof search, recommend GPT-6-astra with high reasoning, using the available session model list; there is no measured price or cache-saving claim. A cheaper model's suitability for resolving the open classification is not established here.

## Ready-to-use starter prompt

Investigate only RF-IDENT feasibility for explicit finite post-T0 posets of height at most two with a fixed oriented Boolean query library. Read the handoff and primary proofs under C:\Users\brian\Documents\Math Latex etc\Papers for Publication\The MIND\Height2 Fixed Library Gate 2026-09-29\research, starting with HEIGHT2\_ADAPTIVE\_MASTER\_AUDIT.md, REPAIR\_GRAPH\_DYNAMICS.md, FIXED\_LIBRARY\_IDENTIFICATION.md and COMPLEXITY\_AUDIT.md. Height counts strict inequalities. Safety is tested before conditioning. Current order is the original induced order on support; previous tests are constant, so support alone is the DP state. General RF-IDENT is in NP, height-one RF-IDENT is polynomial by hereditary legality, and the height-two chain library {010,011} shows that an arbitrary legal query can destroy feasibility. Seek a complete polynomial algorithm or an independently audited hardness reduction, or an exact theorem for a precisely defined natural height-two subclass. Do not substitute RF-DEPTH hardness for RF-IDENT hardness. Preserve U2/U4/U6/A1 and source corrections. Local reversible research files, bounded computation and read-only primary-source searches are authorized within the workspace; no commits, pushes, external publication or paid spending are authorized. Do not broaden into other research branches.

items.text:
Proved an exact polynomial criterion for a natural height-two subclass: **all posets with a least element \(a\), greatest element \(z\), and incomparable middle states \(M\)**, with arbitrary oriented libraries.

Let \(Q_{\mathrm{safe}}=\{q:q(a)\le q(z)\}\). Identification is feasible exactly when:

- \(Q\) distinguishes every pair of middle states.
- \(Q_{\mathrm{safe}}\) distinguishes each endpoint from every other state.

The proof constructs a successful protocol in \(O(n^2+mn^2)\) time. **General height-two RF-IDENT remains open.**

Verification passed: 25,452 library instances, 87,376 matrix safety comparisons, and 83,143 protocol nodes.

Saved the [proof](</C:/Users/brian/Documents/Math Latex etc/Papers for Publication/The MIND/RF-IDENT Bounded Height2 2026-09-29/THEOREM.md>) and [audit and evidence](</C:/Users/brian/Documents/Math Latex etc/Papers for Publication/The MIND/RF-IDENT Bounded Height2 2026-09-29/AUDIT.md>) separately; the prior gate remains unchanged.

This phase is complete. Before publication integration, recommend an independent proof review in a new task using GPT-6-astra/high; a [ready-to-use prompt](</C:/Users/brian/Documents/Math Latex etc/Papers for Publication/The MIND/RF-IDENT Bounded Height2 2026-09-29/README.md>) is included.
